title: Create a file
description: Create a NEW text file in the workspace (the bound target project). Fails if the file already exists — use write_file to overwrite. Forward-slash relative paths like "src/new.js"; the path is confined to the workspace root.

path.description: Relative path inside the workspace for the new file, e.g. "src/new.js".

content.description: Full text content of the new file.

sandbox_permissions.description: Optional strictly wider sandbox mode for this call.

justification.description: Why this exact call needs the wider sandbox mode.

examples: add a README to the project
